notes.name: Karen site meeting 18 Aug
notes.body: foundation trench depth approved, Kevin to pour blinding Friday, Samuel flagged the steel price

notes.name: Karen site meeting 8 Sep
notes.body: columns done to first lift, rain delayed the slab, Faith wants a deeper veranda

notes.name: Karen site meeting 22 Sep
notes.body: roof truss clash with the chimney, Peter to revise, tiles shortlist ready

notes.name: Runda site notes 10 Sep
notes.body: boundary wall leans 4cm, Dennis wants a rooftop deck, survey pegs missing at the north corner

notes.name: Steel prices compared
notes.body: Devki 128 per kg, Mabati 121 per kg, local fundi 118 per kg without receipt

notes.name: Planning submission checklist
notes.body: site plan, floor plans, sections, structural letter, neighbour consents, NCA fee receipt

notes.name: Club rules
notes.body: helmets always, no earphones, wait at the top, dues are 1500 a month

notes.name: Route notes
notes.body: Karura is 32km with two climbs, the loop skips the river crossing, Ngong Hills is 58km

notes.name: Jersey design feedback
notes.body: green and black, Kip wants the logo on the sleeve, Mwende wants a women's cut

notes.name: Kitty rules
notes.body: receipts for anything over 500, two signatures for withdrawals, balance read out at the AGM

notes.name: Simba vaccinations
notes.body: rabies due September, DHPP booster due March, kennel cough in June

notes.name: Simba food and allergies
notes.body: no chicken, fish based kibble, small treats only, wets his bed if he eats beef

notes.name: Dr Wafula's advice
notes.body: ear drops twice a day for ten days, clean with saline, recheck in two months

notes.name: Kitchen tap problem
notes.body: drips at the base, washer or cartridge, ask Salma before calling a plumber

notes.name: Mama's pilau
notes.body: pilau masala, beef on the bone, rice last, cumin first, onions deep brown

notes.name: Tilapia and ugali
notes.body: whole tilapia fried crisp, kachumbari, ugali with cassava flour mix

notes.name: Chapati
notes.body: flour, warm water, oil, rest an hour, fold three times

notes.name: Diary entry - rough site day
notes.body: rain stopped the slab, Faith called twice, ate nothing till four

notes.name: Diary entry - good ride
notes.body: Karura at sunrise, new personal best on the climb, chai with Kevin

notes.name: Berlin Build Week takeaways
notes.body: timber hybrids, passive cooling, check CLT suppliers for Karen

notes.name: Baba birthday ideas
notes.body: reading glasses, a radio for the veranda, kikoi shirt

notes.name: Kisumu house repairs
notes.body: roof leaks over the back room, gutters, wifi router in the sitting room

notes.name: Car reg and tyre pressures
notes.body: KDG 412F, 32 psi front, 30 psi rear, oil change every 5000 km

notes.name: My fee schedule
notes.body: concept 10 percent, working drawings 40 percent, site supervision 15 percent

notes.body: shipping container cafe near Karura gate

notes.name: Scratch list
notes.body: milk, bread, sugar
